title: TRICARE Select Annual Enrollment Fees by Tier
content:
The annual enrollment fee of **TRICARE Select** is set per calendar plan year and per tier. The four TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers are fee-exempt; the two retiree tiers carry an individual fee and a family fee, and only for them do enrollment fees paid for the plan year count toward the family catastrophic cap.

## Fee schedule (US dollars per calendar plan year)

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee-exempt | yes | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Annual fee, individual (exactly one family member enrolled in Select under the sponsor) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 198.00 | 595.08 |
| Annual fee, family (two or more family members enrolled in Select under the sponsor) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 396.00 | 1190.16 |
| Enrollment fees paid for the plan year count toward the family catastrophic cap | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |

## Notes on the schedule

- The individual fee applies when exactly one member of the sponsor family is enrolled in TRICARE Select; the family fee applies when two or more are.
- The family figure is twice the individual figure in both retiree tiers: 198.00 and 396.00 for TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, 595.08 and 1190.16 for TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.
- A fee-exempt tier owes no enrollment fee at all, so it has no installments and nothing that could count toward the cap from fees.

## Illustrative figures (hypothetical families, taken from the table)

| Family | Tier | Annual fee |
|---|---|---|
| One member enrolled | TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 198.00 |
| Spouse and child enrolled | TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 1190.16 |
| Spouse and two children enrolled | TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 0.00 |
